body:
Hi Rene,

I tried to open your website this week, renespaintingmultiservices.com, the address printed on your own Facebook page and in your ads, and it does not open at all. The address cannot be found, so every customer who taps it lands on an error page and moves on to the next painter. Searching makes it no better: look for a painter in Naples and what comes up is your Instagram and your directory listings, not your site. And those listings show (239) 352-8184, while your own ads say (239) 289-6868, so even a customer who does find you has to guess which number actually reaches you.

So I redesigned your homepage, and the finished design is attached to this email as a PDF. It leads with one clear number, (239) 289-6868, puts interior and exterior painting, drywall repair and pressure washing right up front, and makes requesting a quote the easiest thing on the page.

Two similar sites from my portfolio: I built the website for Elkhorn Painting (elkhornpainting.com), a painting company, with its services laid out clearly and quote requests front and center. I also built the site for DreamMaker of Stuart (dreammaker-stuart.com), a home remodeling company, designed to turn visitors into estimate calls.

If you like the design, I can put it on your real domain and build out the rest of the pages. If not, keep the PDF as free ideas, no hard feelings.

Best,
Hassan
name: Rene's Painting
subject: 🎨 Rene, your website does not open at all
